findings.issue: R3 assertion uses eqx.tree_equal inside a @jax.jit function. During JAX tracing, input arrays become abstract tracers. Conditioning fields built from the same input tracers will be identical abstract tracers, so eqx.tree_equal should return True (correct). But if eqx.tree_equal cannot handle abstract types, the assertion could misfire (always raise or always pass). Not confirmed broken, but behavior in JIT trace context is fragile. Comment says 'fires once per JIT compilation' which is the intended semantics.
